The `flaky` service restarts because its command always fails, and `restart: always` brings it back each time.

The command at `docker-compose.yml:4` prints `starting`, writes `fatal: missing DATABASE_URL` to stderr, and runs `exit 3`. The script never checks for a `DATABASE_URL`, so the failure isn't conditional. It exits every time, and Compose restarts it every time.

The compose file doesn't set `DATABASE_URL` either. Line 7 sets `DATABASE_URL_HINT: "set DATABASE_URL"`, which is only a text string, not the variable the script is complaining about. To stop the restart loop, the service needs a real `DATABASE_URL` in its `environment:` block (or an `env_file`), and the command needs to actually use it. Since this is a stub that always exits 3, it will keep failing until the command itself changes.

I didn't change any files. I also noticed `API_SECRET: "s3cr3t-value"` is committed in plaintext, so you may want to move it to an `.env` file or a secret.
